title: Parameterized maximum-influence bound
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ have positive variance, and let $0<\delta<1$. Put $K=I/V$, where $I$ is the total influence of $f$ and $V$ its variance, both for the uniform sign-cube distribution. Then $\left(\frac{1+\delta}{1-\delta}\right)^{1/\delta}\left(\frac1K\right)^{1/\delta}\left(\frac{1-\delta}{1+\delta}\right)^{K/\delta}\le\max_i\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\{−1,1\}$
